entries.text: Mukuru wandje! Mukuru wandje! Hwikika otjiuru tjandje no tjikrone tjohange, kotjiuru tjandje vava ko nomaze omawa, Ove tjiri unovina oviwa novisemba
entries.label: SWB 66

entries.text: Penaune ngumaisapo ouzeu pendje naMukuru? Ii, oMukuru erike. Mukuru ngatangue! Eye oMukuru! Avehe ovakarere Ve. Avehe ngave Mukongorere, nu verikotamene ku Je!
entries.label: SWB 75
